title: Applied Compute Hits $3.25B Valuation Following New $350M Investment
summary:
An AI startup led by former OpenAI researchers has surged from zero to a $100M annual revenue run rate in 18 months. Applied Compute reported that its growth supported a new funding round led by Elad Gil, providing the firm with $350M in capital and establishing a corporate valuation of $3.25B.

The company's workforce has grown threefold since January, with engineers and researchers making up 85% of the staff. Its customers include Microsoft, Shopify and DoorDash, with Applied Compute noting that its inference service reached 1 trillion tokens a day just 12 weeks after launching. Currently, 40% of its clients use the platform for both custom model training and production inference.
